name: Ambient pad
pattern:
stack(
  note("<C Am F G>").s("sine").attack(2).release(4).room(0.9).gain(0.4),
  note("<c4 a3 f3 g3>").s("triangle").attack(1.5).release(3).room(0.8).gain(0.25),
  note("c2").s("sine").attack(3).release(6).gain(0.3)
).slow(4)
progression: C - Am - F - G (I - vi - IV - V)
description: No percussion. Long-attack pads over a sustained C pedal, so the chroma is dominated by harmony rather than transients — the case key detection should handle best and tempo detection should decline to answer.

source.note: No licensed source exists for this genre — Strudel's drum corpus has no techno, trap, ambient or jazz entries, and the community collections are unlicensed. Written by hand; the harmony is stated explicitly in `key` and `progression` so it can be checked against music theory rather than against this project's own analyzer.
